backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the backend that handles user profiles, event registrations (workshop/competition/seminar), and admin stats, with role-based access control via AccessControl and blob storage mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping three background-styling features (beige body color, dark overlay, and preservation of existing components) to their affected file (frontend/src/index.css) and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: A JSON document containing one-sentence summaries of each frontend source file, describing component purposes, recent changes, and key implementation details for build planning reference.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point that defines CSS custom property design tokens for light and dark themes (colors, radius, sidebar, charts) and applies base border and background/foreground styles to all elements.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML shell titled 'ELECTROSPARKS' with a root div and a module script tag loading the React app entry point.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that sets up TanStack Router with all application routes (home, technical, non-technical, register, payment, success, contact, admin, dashboard), wraps the app in QueryClient and RegistrationProvider, and shows a PhoenixIntro splash screen on first visit per session.
frontend/src/components/AdminDashboard.t: Empty file with no content; placeholder for an AdminDashboard component.
frontend/src/components/CircuitPattern.t: Decorative SVG component that renders a tiled orange circuit-board pattern (lines, IC chip, dots) as an absolutely-positioned, non-interactive overlay with configurable opacity.
frontend/src/components/CountdownTimer.t: Displays a live countdown timer to a fixed deadline of March 10, 2026, updating every second and styled with an orange/fire theme.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders a three-column site footer with branding, quick navigation links, and contact info, styled with a dark/orange theme.
frontend/src/components/LoadingScreen.ts: Shows an animated loading screen with a canvas-drawn waveform, progress bar, and cycling status messages, completing after ~3 seconds.
frontend/src/components/Navbar.tsx: Sticky top navigation bar with brand logo, desktop and mobile menu links, active-route highlighting, and scroll-aware background styling.
frontend/src/components/PhoenixIntro.tsx: Full-screen cinematic intro animation featuring a phoenix image, ember particle canvas effect, and an auto-fade-out after ~7 seconds before calling onComplete.
frontend/src/contexts/RegistrationContex: React context that stores and exposes event registration form data (participant info, event type, amount) with set and clear helpers.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an Internet Computer actor (authenticated or anonymous) using React Query, invalidating dependent queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication, including login, logout, and identity persistence via AuthClient from the DFINITY SDK.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines TanStack Query hooks for submitting registrations, fetching all registrations, getting stats, and deleting registrations via the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that sets up a dark neon-cyan cyberpunk theme using Tailwind, custom OKLCH CSS variables, Google Fonts, and utility classes for neon text/border/glow effects.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrapping the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/Admin.tsx: Admin page with a hardcoded credential login form and a control panel dashboard for viewing and managing event registrations, styled with a neon cyberpunk aesthetic.
frontend/src/pages/Contact.tsx: Contact page displaying staff and student coordinator details with an orange neon glow aesthetic, circuit background pattern, and hover-animated glass cards.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Admin dashboard page that lists all registrations with delete confirmation dialogs, Excel export functionality, and formatted event type and timestamp display.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Landing page for VibECX-2K26 symposium featuring an animated hero section with event stats (prize pool, colleges, participants, events), a circuit pattern background, and navigation to registration.
frontend/src/pages/NonTechnicalEvents.ts: Displays a grid of five non-technical events (AD-MAD, JAM, Dump Charades, Talent Show, E-Sports) with icons, descriptions, and hover effects on a dark themed layout.
frontend/src/pages/Payment.tsx: Payment page that reads the registration amount from localStorage, allows users to upload a payment screenshot via drag-and-drop or file input, and submits the registration to the backend before navigating to a success page.
frontend/src/pages/Register.tsx: Registration form page that collects participant details, calculates fees based on event type and member count, saves data to the backend and localStorage, then navigates to the Payment page.
frontend/src/pages/Schedule.tsx: Event schedule page listing 15 timed sessions with venue and description, supporting filter tabs for all, technical, non-technical, and general event types with color-coded badges.
frontend/src/pages/Success.tsx: Displays a registration success page with a confirmation message, event info, and a home navigation button, styled with an orange neon theme on a black background.
frontend/src/pages/TechnicalEvents.tsx: Renders a grid of five technical events (Paper Presentation, PCB Design, Technical Crosscode, Tech Talk, Quiz Master) with icons and descriptions in an orange neon style.
frontend/src/utils/csvExport.ts: Provides a utility to export an array of Registration objects to a CSV file, with helpers to format timestamps and event types.
frontend/src/utils/excelExport.ts: Exports registration data to an Excel (.xlsx) file using SheetJS loaded from CDN, with auto-sized columns and formatted timestamps and event types.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the theme with custom fonts, neon cyan colors, box shadows, border radii, and keyframe animations for the VibECX-2K26 project.
project_state.json: Tracks the project state for VibECX-2K26, recording existing features, architectural notes, and a pending request to apply a warm beige marble global background with a dark overlay.
